outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a data plot.
Panel B consists of representative micrograph/fluorescence/bright-field images, not a quantitative plot requiring individual data points.
Panel C is a bar chart of lactate concentration showing mean with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots for each region/replicate) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel D is a bar chart of lactate concentration comparing high vs low pH regions, showing mean with 95% CI, with individual data points overlaid on the bars.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment model, not a data plot.
